jvm_heap_min_mb.description: Initial heap size (in MB) for the Apache Directory Server JVM. Increase for larger directories (>100k entries).

jvm_heap_max_mb.description: Maximum heap size (in MB) for the JVM. Must be ≥ initial heap; set based on available system RAM and directory size.

enable_gc_logging.description: Enable detailed garbage collection logging for performance analysis and troubleshooting.

gc_log_path.description: File path where GC logs will be written (only used if GC logging is enabled).

instance_dir.description: Root directory containing one or more Apache Directory Server instances.

instance_uid.description: Name of the instance directory under `instance_dir` (e.g., `/var/lib/apacheds/instances/default`).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, or TRACE. Use DEBUG only for diagnostics due to performance impact.

ldap_port.description: TCP port on which the unencrypted LDAP service listens (standard port is 389, but 10389 is the default for apacheds).

ldap_bind_address.description: IP address (or hostname) to bind the LDAP service to. Use '127.0.0.1' for local-only access, or a specific interface IP for production.

enable_ldaps.description: Enable LDAPS (LDAP over SSL/TLS). Requires keystore configuration in the instance’s config.

ldaps_port.description: TCP port for LDAPS (used only if LDAPS is enabled).

ldaps_bind_address.description: IP address for LDAPS binding (used only if LDAPS is enabled).

enable_rmi.description: Enable RMI management port (used by JMX tools). Not recommended in production due to security risks.

rmi_port.description: RMI port for JMX monitoring (used only if RMI is enabled).

enable_debug.description: Enable low-level JVM and Kerberos debug flags (useful for troubleshooting authentication issues).

extra_system_properties.description: Additional JVM system properties in `key=value` format (e.g., for custom environment overrides).

thread_stack_size_kb.description: Thread stack size in KB. Increase only if encountering stack overflow errors.

disable_biased_locking.description: Disable biased locking in the JVM. Useful for high-contention multi-threaded workloads (rarely needed).

classpath.description: JVM classpath. Usually should not be changed unless custom libraries are added.
